result.summary: The page is generally well-structured and visually appealing, with clear navigation and content organization. However, there is a minor layout issue where the last visible restaurant card is cut off at the bottom of the screen, and a minor content issue where the third restaurant name in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated.

issues.description: The last visible restaurant card (pizza image) is cut off at the bottom of the screen, making it look incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the bottom padding or margin of the scrollable content area to ensure the last card is fully visible or clearly indicates that there is more content below.

issues.description: The name of the third restaurant in the 'Fastest near you' section ('Trattoria Piccol...') is truncated, which might make it difficult for users to identify the restaurant.
issues.suggestion: Consider using a smaller font size, abbreviating differently, or allowing the text to wrap to a second line to display the full name.
